description:
Test build, not a release. For stable builds use main/bundles/stable.json.

YouTube player fixes:
- Captions come back after turning them off and on again.
- Bigger captions in portrait (landscape unchanged).
- Controls stay clear of rounded screen corners.
- One loading spinner instead of two.
- At the end of a video, only the replay button shows; tap to replay.
- The screen stays on while a video plays.
